_doc: Routing-fallback calibration report. Recomputed from routing_fallback_corpus.json on every test run; the test fails unless the recomputed values equal these AND the 1.0 targets. precision = fallbacks with a genuine recorded cause (miss / failed-readiness skip / non-terminal error) / all fallbacks. recall = genuine failures that fell through to the next rung / all genuine failures. control_pass_rate = controls with zero fallback and exact expected sequences / all controls. No caching, persistence, or traffic-shaping follows from this report — measurement only.
